description.default: Use data/assets as a netdisk: browse by folder or type, search by filename, preview images and videos, download cloud assets on demand, view and restore per-file versions from data snapshots, and protect the netdisk folder from being deleted.
description.zh-CN: 把 data/assets 当成网盘来用：按目录/类型浏览、搜索文件名、预览图片视频、按需下载云端资源、查看并还原文件的历史版本，并保护网盘目录不被误删。
